hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git push"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'gitleaks is not installed (brew install gitleaks); push blocked' >&2; exit 2; }; gitleaks git --no-banner --redact --log-level error . >&2 && gitleaks dir --no-banner --redact --log-level error . >&2 || { echo 'gitleaks found secrets; push blocked. Scrub them (rewrite history if committed) before pushing.' >&2; exit 2; }
